 Soccer-Simeone salutes Kane's Ballon d'Or as in-form Atletico await Bayern
 Monday, 02 Nov 2026
 | 9:47 PM MYT
 share 
 bookmark 
 Soccer Football - LaLiga - Levante v Atletico Madrid - Estadi Ciutat de Valencia, Valencia, Spain - October 31, 2026 Atletico Madrid coach Diego Simeone reacts REUTERS/Pablo Morano 
 MADRID, Nov 2 (Reuters) - Atletico ⁠Madrid manager Diego Simeone hailed Harry Kane as ⁠a worthy Ballon d'Or winner as his buoyant ‌side prepare to put their nine-game unbeaten run on the line against Bayern Munich in the Champions League on Tuesday.
 Simeone praised the England ​captain's enduring scoring instinct ahead of the ⁠clash at the Metropolitano ⁠stadium.
 "Firstly, I'd like to congratulate him on his well-deserved Ballon ⁠d'Or. ‌It's incredible – I've always admired him," Simeone said.
 "As he's matured over the years, he's found his ⁠best form without losing his eye for ​goal; he knows ‌what the team needs."
 The Argentine said Kane's influence extended ⁠beyond his ​performances.
 "His talent is a real asset to the game and to the young players who look up to him, because ⁠he leaves a legacy showing that ​you can achieve great things through hard work."
 Atletico have won eight of their last nine matches in all competitions, including ⁠a 2-1 LaLiga derby victory over Real Madrid.
 They sit 16th in the Champions League standings with four points from three matches, one point behind 14th-placed Bayern, who arrive after ​successive draws in the competition.
 "Finding that ⁠balance and consistency is the hardest part, and it's what ​all of us coaches want," Simeone ‌said.
 "We need to enjoy the ​run and approach it with enthusiasm as we move forward."
 (Reporting by Fernando Kallas, editing by Ed Osmond)
